ctxTalking:
• Solana’s strengthened position in RWA markets, despite Ethereum’s continued dominance

ctxSignal:
Signal: Growth in tokenized assets and ecosystem capacity, plus increased leverage risks.
Noise: Short-term price swings not clearly linked to underlying network fundamentals.
